nodes.label: Next.js Breaking Changes Warning
nodes.rationale: This project uses a version of Next.js with breaking changes from standard training data. Developers must read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing any code, as APIs, conventions, and file structure may differ. This is a guard against incorrect assumptions about Next.js behavior.

nodes.label: Next.js Docs in node_modules
nodes.rationale: The authoritative Next.js documentation for this project is located at node_modules/next/dist/docs/ — not online or in training data — because the installed version has breaking API changes.
